description.value: Bambu is a Vietnamese-inspired café specializing in signature dessert drinks, traditional chè beverages, and Vietnamese coffee. A convenient refreshment stop for touring cyclists seeking specialty drinks or light snacks.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 6m; wall_loops (12 spaces, covered) at 43m; stands (14 spaces) at 65m; stands (2 spaces) at 90m; stands (2 spaces) at 94m. Total: 34 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Bambu is an active Vietnamese-inspired café/beverage shop at 1090 Kingsway serving signature dessert drinks, coffee, and teas with takeout/Uber Eats delivery available. Operating hours (Monday–Sunday 12pm–9pm) and 2026 copyright date confirm it is currently open. Website provides phone (604.336.9009) and complete address with postal code (V5V 3C6). No information about bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cyclist-specific amenities is mentioned on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible beverage café offering takeout service. Useful to touring cyclists as a convenient stop for refreshments.
